title: A rectangle anchored inside a run
concept: A Rectangle nested inside a CharacterStyleRange is an anchored object; the parser reads it (geometry + AnchoredObjectSetting) onto the host paragraph instead of treating it as a free spread item.

annotations.note: The host run. The anchored object is a child of this CharacterStyleRange, not a sibling of the frame on the spread.
Content comes first — the literal text the object is anchored into.
A Rectangle nested directly inside the run is an anchored object. GeometricBounds and FillColor are read just like a spread-level frame; the bounds give it a 36x72pt box.
AnchoredObjectSetting carries the placement intent. AnchoredPosition="InlinePosition" requests inline (glyph-space) anchoring; AnchorPoint names which corner of the object lands on the anchor.
